repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

repos.description: :tada: A magical vue admin                                                                https://panjiachen.github.io/vue-element-admin
repos.summary_zh: vue-element-admin 是一个基于 Vue 2.6+ 和 Element UI 2.7+ 的现代化企业级后台管理系统解决方案，提供国际化支持、权限管理、数据可视化等完整功能，支持快速搭建复杂单页应用，适用于中大型管理后台开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-element-admin is a production-ready front-end solution for admin interfaces built on Vue 2.6+ and Element UI 2.7+. It features i18n support, role-based permissions, dashboard widgets, and enterprise-grade templates to accelerate development of complex single-page applications.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: The Web framework for perfectionists with deadlines.
repos.summary_zh: Django 是一个高级 Python Web 框架，专为追求高效开发流程的务实开发者设计。它提供开箱即用的功能，支持快速构建安全、可维护的 Web 应用，内置 ORM、管理后台、认证系统和 URL 路由等核心组件，极大提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Django is a high-level Python web framework designed for developers who value rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It provides built-in features like ORM, admin interface, authentication, and URL routing, enabling secure and maintainable web application development with minimal boilerplate code.

repos.description: Independent technology for modern publishing, memberships, subscriptions and newsletters.
repos.summary_zh: Ghost 是一个现代化的开源 Node.js 内容管理系统（CMS），专为独立创作者、会员订阅和新闻通讯设计。它提供强大的发布工具、会员管理和订阅功能，支持无头架构，可灵活集成前端框架。核心优势包括简洁的编辑器、SEO 优化、自动化工作流和 Ghost(Pro) 托管服务，适合个人博客、媒体网站及内容变现平台。
repos.summary_en: Ghost is a modern, open-source Node.js CMS designed for professional publishing, memberships, subscriptions, and newsletters. It offers a clean editor, SEO tools, and headless architecture for flexible front-end integration. With features like automated workflows and Ghost(Pro) managed hosting, it's ideal for creators and publishers seeking a developer-friendly, scalable platform.

repos.description: A visual no-code/code-free web crawler/spider易采集：一个可视化浏览器自动化测试/数据采集/爬虫软件，可以无代码图形化的设计和执行爬虫任务。别名：ServiceWrapper面向Web应用的智能化服务封装系统。
repos.summary_zh: 易采集/EasySpider 是一款完全免费的视觉无代码浏览器自动化工具，支持图形化设计爬虫任务，无需编程即可实现网页数据采集与自动化测试。通过可视化操作选择网页元素，自动识别同类内容并批量采集，同时支持命令行模式嵌入其他系统，适用于电商、数据抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: EasySpider is a completely free visual no-code web crawler and browser automation tool that enables users to design and execute data collection tasks through a graphical interface without programming. It automatically detects similar elements on web pages, supports batch data extraction, and can also run via command line for integration into other systems, ideal for e-commerce scraping and automation testing.

repos.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
repos.summary_zh: AionUi 是一款免费、开源的 AI 协作者应用，支持 24/7 自动化，内置多 AI 智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Qwen Code 等），提供跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）本地运行、零配置启动、远程访问（WebUI/Telegram/Lark）和任务调度功能，适用于代码开发、文件处理与自动化工作流。
repos.summary_en: AionUi is a free, open-source AI coworking app that enables 24/7 automation with built-in multi-agent support (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code). It offers zero-setup local execution, cross-platform compatibility, remote access via WebUI/Telegram, and scheduled task automation for coding, file operations, and workflow management.

repos.description: A UI library by WeChat official design team, includes the most useful widgets/modules in mobile web applications.
repos.summary_zh: WeUI 是腾讯微信官方设计团队打造的开源 UI 库，专为微信小程序和 Web 应用设计，提供丰富的移动端组件（如按钮、表单、弹窗等），确保与微信生态一致的用户体验，支持快速构建美观、标准化的移动 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: WeUI is an open-source UI library developed by Tencent's WeChat design team, specifically tailored for WeChat web and mini-program development. It offers a comprehensive set of mobile-first components (e.g., buttons, forms, dialogs) to deliver a consistent and standardized user experience across WeChat ecosystems, enabling rapid development of visually appealing mobile web apps.

repos.description: 基于 ChatGPT API 的划词翻译浏览器插件和跨平台桌面端应用    -    Browser extension and cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 ChatGPT API 的智能划词翻译工具，支持浏览器插件和跨平台桌面应用。提供翻译、润色、摘要三大功能，覆盖55种语言互译，支持流式响应、文本朗读、截图翻译及多LLM平台接入（OpenAI/Azure/MiniMax），具备词汇本管理和记忆辅助生成能力。
repos.summary_en: An intelligent word-selection translator powered by ChatGPT API, available as both a browser extension and cross-platform desktop app. Offers translation, polishing, and summarization across 55 languages, with streaming support, TTS, screenshot translation, vocabulary books, and multi-LLM provider integration (OpenAI/Azure/MiniMax).

repos.description: A next.js web application that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams. This app allows you to create, modify, and enhance diagrams through natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization.
repos.summary_zh: Next AI Draw.io 是一个基于 Next.js 的 AI 驱动图表设计工具，通过自然语言指令与 AI 辅助可视化，支持创建、修改和增强 draw.io 风格的流程图与架构图，集成多模态 AI 能力与云服务商图标库。
repos.summary_en: Next AI Draw.io is a Next.js-based web app that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams, enabling users to create, modify, and enhance diagrams via natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization, featuring multi-cloud icon support and real-time diagram generation.

repos.description: 全面ESM+Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript编写的一款后台管理系统（兼容移动端）
repos.summary_zh: vue-pure-admin 是一款基于 ESM 规范的现代化中后台管理系统模板，采用 Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript 技术栈构建，支持移动端适配。提供完整的前端架构与组件库，包含国际化精简版本，打包体积优化至350KB以下，配套详细文档与视频教程，支持 Docker 部署与 Gitpod 在线开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-pure-admin is a modern admin template built with ESM standard, using Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript stack. It supports mobile adaptation, offers complete frontend architecture and component library, includes i18n thin version with optimized bundle size under 350KB, and provides comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, Docker support, and Gitpod integration.

repos.description: Share your terminal as a web application
repos.summary_zh: GoTTY 是一个将命令行工具转换为 Web 应用的轻量级工具，支持通过浏览器远程访问终端会话。它提供端口监听、TLS 加密、基础认证、随机 URL 生成等安全特性，适用于运维、开发调试和远程协作场景。
repos.summary_en: GoTTY is a lightweight CLI tool that transforms command-line tools into web-based applications, enabling remote terminal access via browsers. It supports secure features like TLS encryption, basic authentication, random URL generation, and dynamic resizing for use in operations, debugging, and remote collaboration.

repos.description: Mobile UI Components based on Vue & WeUI
repos.summary_zh: Vux 是基于 Vue 2.3+ 和 WeUI 构建的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的微信风格组件与交互效果。支持 webpack 构建，集成数据绑定与事件处理，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用，兼容主流移动浏览器。
repos.summary_en: Vux is a mobile UI component library built on Vue 2.3+ and WeUI, offering rich WeChat-style components and interactions. It supports webpack build, data binding, and event handling, ideal for rapid mobile web app development with broad browser compatibility.

repos.description: GUI for ChatGPT API and many LLMs. Supports agents, file-based QA, GPT finetuning and query with web search. All with a neat UI.
repos.summary_zh: 川虎 Chat 是一款为 ChatGPT 等多种大语言模型设计的轻量级 Web GUI，支持多模态 API、本地部署模型及 Agent 助理。提供文件问答、微调训练、联网搜索等功能，配备现代化毛玻璃 UI 和移动端适配，并支持历史记录管理与 PWA 安装。
repos.summary_en: Chuanhu Chat is a lightweight web GUI for ChatGPT and other LLMs, supporting multiple APIs, local models, agents, file-based QA, fine-tuning, and web search. Features a modern UI with glassmorphism, mobile support, history management, and PWA installation.

repos.description: Use Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, and Codex on mobile and web with CloudCLI (aka Claude Code UI). CloudCLI is a free open source webui/GUI that helps you manage your Claude Code session and projects remotely.
repos.summary_zh: CloudCLI 是一个开源的 Claude Code、Cursor CLI、Codex 和 Gemini-CLI 的统一 WebUI/GUI，支持桌面和移动端远程管理 AI 编程助手会话与项目。提供交互式聊天、集成终端、文件浏览器、Git 操作等功能，具备插件扩展能力，支持多模型兼容，可通过 npx 快速体验或部署到云端。
repos.summary_en: CloudCLI is a free open-source webui/GUI that provides a unified interface for managing Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Codex, and Gemini-CLI sessions and projects remotely from mobile or desktop. Features include responsive design, integrated chat, shell terminal, file explorer, Git tools, plugin system, and multi-model support via CloudCLI Cloud or self-hosted deployment.

repos.description: 最接近原生APP体验的高性能框架
repos.summary_zh: mui 是一个专为移动端 HTML5 应用设计的高性能框架，有效解决了浏览器原生体验差的问题，如白屏、动画卡顿、下拉刷新不流畅等。它提供接近原生 APP 的流畅交互与丰富 UI 控件，支持与 HBuilder 开发工具深度集成，显著提升移动端 Web 应用开发效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: mui is a high-performance framework for mobile HTML5 apps, addressing core issues like page flickering, poor animations, and unsmooth pull-to-refresh. It delivers near-native app experiences with rich UI components and seamless integration with HBuilder, enabling efficient development of smooth, visually appealing mobile web applications.

repos.description: Essential UI blocks for building mobile web apps.
repos.summary_zh: Ant Design Mobile 是构建移动端 Web 应用的核心 UI 组件库，提供高性能、可定制的原子化组件，支持 CSS 变量主题定制与流畅动画，适用于快速开发跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: Ant Design Mobile is a core UI component library for building mobile web apps, offering high-performance, customizable atomic components with CSS variable theming and smooth animations for cross-platform mobile development.

repos.description: 本项目采用 CC BY-NC-SA 协议，禁止任何商业化行为，任何衍生项目必须保留本项目地址并以相同协议开源
repos.summary_zh: MoonTV 是一款基于 Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 构建的跨平台影视聚合播放器，支持多源搜索、在线 HLS 播放、收藏同步及 PWA 离线缓存。采用 Kvrocks/Redis 存储播放进度，集成 ArtPlayer 与 HLS.js 实现流畅播放体验，支持响应式设计与智能去广告功能。
repos.summary_en: MoonTV is a cross-platform video aggregation player built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It supports multi-source search, HLS streaming via ArtPlayer/HLS.js, cloud-synced watchlist, and PWA offline caching. Uses Kvrocks/Redis for playback progress storage with responsive UI and experimental ad-blocking.

repos.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web 插件聚合生态 · 万物皆插件，通过创意工坊分发｜｜DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web Plugin Aggregation Ecosystem · Everything is a plugin, distributed via the Creative Workshop
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Use your locally running AI models to assist you in your web browsing
repos.summary_zh: Page Assist 是一款开源浏览器扩展，通过本地运行 AI 模型（如 Ollama）为网页浏览提供智能助手功能。支持 Chrome、Firefox 等主流浏览器，具备侧边栏交互和独立 Web UI 两种使用方式，用户可直接在任意网页中与本地 AI 对话，实现网页内容问答与知识提取。
repos.summary_en: Page Assist is an open-source browser extension that enables interaction with locally running AI models (e.g., via Ollama) directly from any webpage. It offers a sidebar and standalone web UI for Chromium-based browsers like Chrome, Firefox, and Edge, allowing users to chat with webpage content using their own AI model.

repos.description: 🧑‍🚀 全世界最好的LLM资料总结（多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练、模型推理、o1 模型、MCP、小语言模型、视觉语言模型） | Summary of the world's best LLM resources.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是全网最全面的大语言模型（LLM）资源汇总，涵盖多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练与推理等全链路技术方向，持续更新维护，为研究者与开发者提供权威的一站式学习与实践指南。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the most comprehensive collection of LLM resources globally, covering multimodal generation, agents, code assistance, AI review, data processing, model training and inference, and more. It serves as an authoritative one-stop guide for researchers and developers, continuously updated.

repos.description: It's a new file uploader solution!
repos.summary_zh: WebUploader 是一个基于 HTML5 为主、Flash 为辅的现代文件上传组件，兼容 IE6+ 及移动端。支持大文件分片并发上传、图片预览压缩、拖拽粘贴添加文件，并提供 MD5 秒传与模块化扩展能力，显著提升上传效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: WebUploader is a modern file uploader built primarily on HTML5 with Flash fallback, supporting IE6+ and mobile browsers. It enables chunked concurrent uploads, image preview/compression, drag-and-drop/paste file addition, MD5 instant upload, and modular extensibility for enhanced performance and flexibility.

repos.description: 一个简单的本地网页界面，使用ChatTTS将文字合成为语音，同时支持对外提供API接口。A simple native web interface that uses ChatTTS to synthesize text into speech, along with support for external API interfaces.
repos.summary_zh: ChatTTS-ui 是一个本地网页界面，基于 ChatTTS 模型实现文字转语音功能，支持中英文及数字混合文本合成，并提供 API 接口供外部调用。支持 Windows 预打包版、Linux 容器及源码部署，兼容 CPU/GPU 加速（NVIDIA CUDA 或 AMD ROCm），首次运行自动下载模型文件。
repos.summary_en: ChatTTS-ui is a local web interface that uses the ChatTTS model to synthesize text into speech, supporting mixed Chinese-English text and numbers, with external API support. It offers pre-packaged Windows version, Linux container deployment, and source code setup, with CPU/GPU acceleration via NVIDIA CUDA or AMD ROCm, and automatic model download on first run.

repos.description: an elegant efficient express mvvm framework
repos.summary_zh: Avalon2 是一个高效优雅的 MVVM 前端框架，支持双向数据绑定与组件化开发，具备优异的渲染性能与后端渲染能力。它兼容 IE6+，提供丰富的指令系统（如 ms-duplex、ms-if）和组件开发支持，适用于构建高性能单页应用（SPA）。
repos.summary_en: Avalon2 is an elegant and efficient MVVM framework for frontend development, featuring two-way data binding, componentization, and high-performance rendering. It supports server-side rendering, IE6+ compatibility, and provides a rich directive system (e.g., ms-duplex, ms-if) for building scalable single-page applications (SPAs).

repos.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI 插件与皮肤生态：一切皆插件。任务看板、移动端远程与 SSH 运维构筑开发工作台；皮肤经 WebGL 深度优化，更支持 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸；皮肤、宠物、插件由 DSH 大市场一键安装，正迈向 DSH 创意工坊。A pluggable plugin-skin ecosystem for the DSH Web GUI - Task board, remote mobile UI, SSH ops, WebGL-optimized skins with Wallpaper Engine wallpapers - becoming a DSH creative workshop.
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Yet Another Clash Dashboard
repos.summary_zh: yacd 是一个现代化的 Clash 代理控制面板，提供简洁直观的 Web 界面用于管理代理规则、流量监控和配置。支持通过 URL 参数动态连接不同 Clash 后端实例，具备深色/浅色主题切换功能，可通过 Docker 快速部署，适用于个人或企业网络代理管理场景。
repos.summary_en: Yet Another Clash Dashboard (yacd) is a modern, clean web interface for managing Clash proxy configurations. It enables real-time traffic monitoring, rule management, and dynamic backend connection via URL parameters. Features include dark/light theme support and easy deployment via Docker, ideal for personal or enterprise proxy administration.

repos.description: Making AJAX as easy as anchor tags
repos.summary_zh: Intercooler 是一个轻量级（6.74KB gzipped）的 AJAX 增强库，通过 HTML 属性即可实现类似锚标签的异步交互。它支持事件触发、进度指示、RESTful 依赖、AJAX 历史记录等功能，无需编写 JavaScript 即可构建现代 Web 应用，适用于渐进式增强现有项目。
repos.summary_en: Intercooler is a lightweight (6.74KB gzipped) library that enables AJAX functionality using HTML attributes, similar to anchor tags. It supports event triggers, progress indicators, RESTful dependencies, AJAX history, and more, allowing developers to build modern web apps with minimal JavaScript, ideal for incremental enhancement of existing applications.

repos.description: A JavaScript library for rendering music notation and guitar tablature.
repos.summary_zh: VexFlow 是一个开源的 JavaScript 音乐符号渲染库，支持在浏览器和 Node.js 环境中生成乐谱与吉他谱。基于 TypeScript 开发，输出 HTML Canvas 和 SVG 格式，提供易用的 EasyScore 高级 API 以及灵活的底层 Native API，适用于网页、命令行工具及 PDF 导出等场景。
repos.summary_en: VexFlow is an open-source JavaScript library for rendering music notation and guitar tablature. Written in TypeScript and compiled to ES6, it outputs scores to HTML Canvas and SVG, supporting both browsers and Node.js environments (e.g., CLI tools for PDF generation). It offers a high-level EasyScore API and a flexible low-level Native API.

repos.description: Enhanced MCP server for interactive user feedback and command execution in AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and Desktop Application) with intelligent environment detection and cross-platform compatibility.
repos.summary_zh: MCP Feedback Enhanced 是一个增强型 MCP 服务器，专为 AI 辅助开发设计，支持 Web UI 和跨平台桌面应用双界面，具备智能环境检测与反馈驱动工作流，可显著降低平台成本并提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: MCP Feedback Enhanced is an enhanced MCP server designed for AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and cross-platform desktop app) with intelligent environment detection and feedback-driven workflows to reduce platform costs and boost development efficiency.

repos.description: 基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B等系列LLM的针对本地知识库的自动问答
repos.summary_zh: 本项目基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B系列大模型，构建了一个针对本地知识库的自动问答Web应用。支持上传PDF、TXT、DOCX、MD等格式文档，结合多种Embedding模型实现语义检索，提供本地部署和云端体验，适用于私有知识问答、文档理解等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project builds a web-based QA system using LangChain and ChatGLM-6B series LLMs for local knowledge base queries. It supports uploading PDF, TXT, DOCX, MD files and integrates multiple embedding models for semantic retrieval, enabling private, offline document understanding and question answering.

repos.description: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
repos.summary_zh: RAG Web UI 是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）技术的智能对话系统，支持多格式文档管理与向量化处理，提供精准知识问答服务。系统具备前后端分离架构、分布式文件存储及高性能向量数据库（如 ChromaDB、Qdrant），支持 OpenAI、DeepSeek 及本地 Ollama 模型部署，适用于私有化部署与 API 集成场景。
repos.summary_en: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology, enabling precise knowledge-based Q&A through document retrieval and LLM integration. It supports multi-format document ingestion, asynchronous processing, vectorization, and flexible LLM deployment (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), with a scalable backend architecture and OpenAPI for external access.

repos.description: splinter - python test framework for web applications
repos.summary_zh: Splinter 是一个简洁易用的 Python Web 应用自动化测试框架，提供直观的 API 支持浏览器交互自动化。它基于 Selenium 构建，支持多浏览器驱动，具备快速开发、灵活扩展和真实场景适配能力，适用于 Web 测试、爬虫及自动化任务。
repos.summary_en: Splinter is a simple and consistent Python framework for automating web applications. Built on Selenium, it offers an intuitive API for browser automation, supporting multiple drivers and real-world use cases. Ideal for testing, scraping, and UI automation with robust and flexible capabilities.

repos.description: Pipelines: Versatile, UI-Agnostic OpenAI-Compatible Plugin Framework
repos.summary_zh: Pipelines 是 Open WebUI 推出的开源插件框架，支持在任意兼容 OpenAI API 的 UI 客户端中运行自定义 Python 工作流。它允许开发者通过轻量代码扩展功能，如实现 RAG、消息监控、翻译过滤等复杂逻辑，适用于需要高性能计算或定制化 AI 流程的场景。
repos.summary_en: Pipelines is an open-source plugin framework by Open WebUI that enables modular, customizable workflows for any UI client supporting OpenAI API specs. It allows developers to extend functionality with custom Python logic—such as RAG, message monitoring, or translation filters—ideal for offloading heavy computations from main instances.

repos.description: Simple and complete web UI framework to create web apps with Windows 8 Metro user interface, based on Bootstrap 2.
repos.summary_zh: BootMetro 是一个基于 Bootstrap 2 的 Web UI 框架，专为创建具有 Windows 8 Metro 风格界面的应用而设计，无需依赖 Windows 8 系统。它整合了 HTML5 Boilerplate 和 IcoMoon 图标库，提供 Metro 风格的布局、磁贴、通知、列表视图和翻转视图等组件，适用于企业内部网等现代 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: BootMetro is a web UI framework built on Bootstrap 2, designed to create web apps with the Windows 8 MetroUI style without requiring Windows 8. It integrates HTML5 Boilerplate and IcoMoon icons, offering Metro-styled layouts, tiles, toasts, list views, and flip views, ideal for modern intranet applications.

repos.description: 妈妈计划-众人拾柴火焰高
repos.summary_zh: 妈妈计划2（MAMA2）是一个开源项目，旨在解决MacBook观看在线视频时发热严重的问题，通过将Flash播放器替换为HTML5 Video实现。项目支持哔哩哔哩、优酷、土豆、芒果TV等主流视频网站，采用模块化架构，开发者可编写seeker脚本解析视频源地址。支持本地开发环境搭建，具备跨域请求、日志记录等工具函数，鼓励社区参与扩展支持网站。
repos.summary_en: MAMA2 is an open-source project designed to resolve overheating issues in MacBooks when watching online videos by replacing Flash players with HTML5 Video. It supports major platforms like Bilibili, Youku, Tudou, and more. The project uses a modular architecture where developers can write 'seeker' scripts to extract video URLs. It includes tools for AJAX, logging, and cross-domain requests, with a local development environment using Node.js and Gulp. Community contributions are encouraged to expand site support.

repos.summary_zh: OpenAI账号管理系统v2，提供Web界面管理多邮箱服务注册、并发批量操作、代理池、账号生命周期管理及多种导出格式（JSON/CSV/CPA/Sub2API），支持实时日志推送与支付升级功能，适用于自动化账号管理与分发。
repos.summary_en: OpenAI Account Management System v2 is a Web UI tool for managing OpenAI account registration across multiple email services, supporting concurrent batch operations, proxy pools, account lifecycle management, and export formats (JSON/CSV/CPA/Sub2API), with real-time logging and payment upgrade features.

repos.description: outlookEmail 支持 Outlook/Hotmail、Gmail、QQ、163、126、Yahoo、阿里邮箱以及自定义 IMAP 邮箱，同时集成 GPTMail、DuckMail、Cloudflare Temp Email 多提供商临时邮箱能力
repos.summary_zh: 多邮箱邮件管理工具，支持 Outlook OAuth、Microsoft Graph API 和 IMAP 协议统一读取管理 Outlook/Gmail/QQ/163/Yahoo 等主流邮箱，提供 Web 界面实现分组代理、别名转发、临时邮箱集成及对外 API 调用，具备缓存优化、批量操作和安全防护能力。
repos.summary_en: Multi-email management tool supporting Outlook OAuth, Microsoft Graph API and IMAP protocols to unify access to Outlook/Gmail/QQ/163/Yahoo accounts. Features web interface for group-based proxy routing, alias forwarding, temporary email integration, and external API with caching, batch operations, and security protections.

repos.description: Chat2API enables zero-cost access to leading AI models by leveraging official web UIs. It supports providers such as DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, and Z.ai, and seamlessly integrates with tools like openlcaw, Cline, and Roo-Code.
repos.summary_zh: Chat2API 是一款跨平台 AI 服务统一管理工具，通过官方 Web UI 实现零成本接入 DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、MiniMax、Qwen、Z.ai 等主流大模型。支持 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，无缝集成 openlcaw、Cline、Roo-Code 等开发工具，提供上下文管理、函数调用、模型映射等高级功能，并配备实时监控仪表盘与代理配置能力。
repos.summary_en: Chat2API is a cross-platform unified management tool for AI services, enabling zero-cost access to leading models like DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, and Z.ai via official web UIs. It provides OpenAI-compatible APIs, seamless integration with tools such as openlcaw, Cline, and Roo-Code, advanced features like context management, function calling, model mapping, and real-time monitoring dashboard with proxy support.

repos.description: 通过对话挖掘用户需求，并自动生成专业的提示词，支持系统/用户提示词优化、效果对比，版本管理和支持即时渲染的操练场，新增通过多轮对话绘图改图，图片逆推提示词、绘图提示词优化，https://yprompt.252035.xyz   公共账号：demo / demo
repos.summary_zh: YPrompt 是一款 AI 驱动的提示词生成与优化工具，通过多轮对话精准挖掘用户需求并自动生成专业系统提示词。支持提示词版本管理、效果对比及即时渲染操练场，新增多轮对话绘图改图、图片逆推提示词、提示词翻译等功能，提供 Linux.do、飞书等多认证方式，适配桌面与移动端响应式设计。
repos.summary_en: YPrompt is an AI-powered prompt generation and optimization tool that uses conversational dialogue to extract user needs and automatically generates professional system prompts. It supports prompt versioning, effect comparison, real-time rendering playground, multi-turn image generation/editing, reverse-prompting from images, and prompt translation. Features multi-auth (Linux.do, Feishu), dual-database support (SQLite/MySQL), and responsive design for desktop/mobile.

repos.description: A more beautiful and easier-to-use alternative to OpenClaw. It features a nicer Web UI, built-in IM support, a sandboxed runtime and channel-based team collaboration. Under the hood, it is powered by a Claude Code–based agent.
repos.summary_zh: Poco 是一款基于 Claude Code 的智能体平台，提供比 OpenClaw 更美观易用的替代方案。核心特性包括安全沙箱环境、多模态文件支持、原生 Claude Code 交互体验（计划模式/提问模式）、内置浏览器与 GitHub 集成、MCP/Skills 扩展能力，以及钉钉/飞书/Telegram 消息集成。采用 Next.js + FastAPI 架构，支持 Docker 一键部署和移动端访问。
repos.summary_en: Poco is a safer and more user-friendly alternative to OpenClaw, powered by a Claude Code-based agent. It features a secure sandboxed runtime, native Claude Code experience (Plan Mode, AskQuestion), built-in browser, GitHub integration, MCP/Skills extensibility, IM integrations (DingTalk/Feishu/Telegram), and multilingual support. Built with Next.js + FastAPI, deployable via Docker with mobile access.

repos.description: WebSockets for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-socketio 是一个 BSD 许可的 Django 应用，通过集成 gevent-socketio 实现 WebSocket 支持，提供频道订阅、事件广播和信号式事件系统，支持实时通信与自动重载服务器，适用于需要实时交互的 Django 项目。
repos.summary_en: django-socketio is a BSD-licensed Django application that enables WebSocket support via gevent-socketio, offering channel-based subscriptions, event broadcasting, and a signals-like event system for real-time communication in Django projects.

repos.description: ❤️‍🔥 A chrome extension as an alternative to Notion AI that goes beyond Notion AI. | 一个替代 Notion AI 的浏览器插件，不止于 Notion AI
repos.summary_zh: Writely 是一款基于 OpenAI GPT 模型的浏览器插件，旨在替代 Notion AI。它支持在任意网页编辑器中提供智能写作辅助、邮件撰写、文章创作及社交媒体互动等功能，显著提升用户的内容创作效率与质量，实现跨平台的智能文本处理体验。
repos.summary_en: Writely is a browser extension powered by OpenAI's GPT model, designed as an alternative to Notion AI. It enables intelligent writing assistance across any webpage editor, supporting email composition, article drafting, and social media interactions, thereby enhancing content creation efficiency and quality with cross-platform accessibility.

repos.description: A feature-rich, efficient text editor - Web Site
repos.summary_zh: Yu Writer Site 是一个功能丰富、高效的文本编辑器网站，提供现代化的写作体验。支持 Markdown 编辑、实时预览、多主题切换和本地存储，适用于内容创作者和开发者。项目采用轻量级架构，注重性能与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: Yu Writer Site is a feature-rich, efficient text editor web application offering a modern writing experience. It supports Markdown editing, live preview, multi-theme switching, and local storage, ideal for content creators and developers. Built with a lightweight architecture focused on performance and user experience.

repos.description: 基于官方OpenWebUI，汉化界面提高中文使用体验，增加了模型计费和用量统计
repos.summary_zh: HaloWebUI 是基于 Open WebUI 深度定制的中文 AI 自托管平台，集成 Claude/Gemini/xAI 等多模型路由与知识检索增强功能。提供原生中文界面、模型计费统计及 HaloClaw 消息网关，支持 Docker 一键部署与全链路可控的对话管理。
repos.summary_en: HaloWebUI is a Chinese-localized self-hosted AI platform built on Open WebUI, featuring multi-model routing (Claude/Gemini/xAI), knowledge retrieval enhancement, and cost tracking. It includes native Chinese UI, HaloClaw message gateway, and Docker deployment support for full conversational control.

repos.description: Gemini Nexus 是一款面向浏览器场景的 AI 助手扩展，集成 Gemini Web、Gemini API 与 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持网页上下文、图像处理、工具调用和 MCP 浏览器控制。
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini 能力的 Chrome 扩展程序，通过悬浮工具栏、图像 AI 处理及浏览器控制协议 (MCP)，实现网页交互的智能化增强。支持多驱动 API（Web Client/官方 API/OpenAI兼容）、上下文管理、历史消息编辑及基于 DevTools Protocol 的自动化操作，为浏览器内 AI 工作流提供原生级体验。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Nexus is a Chrome extension deeply integrated with Google Gemini, featuring an injected floating toolbar, image AI processing, and browser control via MCP. It supports multiple API drivers (Web Client/Official/OpenAI Compatible), context management, message history editing, and automation through Chrome DevTools Protocol for native AI-enhanced browsing workflows.

repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Next.js 的对话型 Web 应用模板，专为集成 Dify AI 平台设计。支持通过环境变量配置 APP ID、API Key 和接口地址，提供 Docker 部署方案，具备多语言支持和自定义提示词功能，适用于快速构建企业级智能对话界面。
repos.summary_en: This is a Next.js-based conversational web app template designed for Dify AI platform integration. It supports configuration via environment variables (APP ID, API Key, URL), offers Docker deployment, multi-language support, and customizable prompts, enabling rapid development of enterprise-grade AI chat interfaces.

repos.description: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini 能力的 Chrome 扩展程序。它不仅仅是一个侧边栏插件，而是通过注入式的悬浮工具栏、强大的图像 AI 处理以及前沿的浏览器控制协议 (MCP)，将 AI 的触角伸向网页浏览的每一个交互细节。
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini AI 的 Chrome 扩展程序，通过悬浮工具栏、图像 AI 处理和浏览器控制协议 (MCP) 实现网页交互的智能增强。支持三种驱动方案（Web Client/官方 API/OpenAI兼容），提供划词翻译、OCR截图翻译、水印消除等功能，并基于 Accessibility Tree 实现精准页面操作。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Nexus is a Chrome extension deeply integrated with Google Gemini AI, enhancing web browsing through an injected floating toolbar, image AI processing, and Browser Control Protocol (MCP). It supports three provider modes (Web Client/Official API/OpenAI Compatible), offering features like text selection translation, OCR screenshot translation, watermark removal, and precise page control via Accessibility Tree.

repos.description: 完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App | Completely free, open-source, collaborative accounting Web App
repos.summary_zh: Cent 是一款完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App，基于 GitHub 仓库实现数据同步与版本控制，无需服务器即可跨平台实时协作。支持语音记账、AI 智能分析、多币种管理、地图可视化、周期记账等高级功能，采用纯前端 PWA 架构，数据完全自持于用户私有仓库，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Cent is a completely free, open-source collaborative accounting web app that uses GitHub repositories for data synchronization and version control, enabling real-time cross-platform collaboration without servers. It supports advanced features like voice记账, AI analysis, multi-currency management, map visualization, and recurring transactions. Built as a pure frontend PWA with data stored in user-owned private repositories for full privacy and security.

repos.description: berserkJS 是新形态的前端测试自动化工具 + 页面性能分析工具 ，同时也是个使用 JS 语法控制的命令行浏览器。可用 JS 编写前端自动测试用例 + 页面性能分析用例。 想了解更多？看看连接中的文档吧~~
repos.summary_zh: berserkJS 是一款基于 Qt 的前端自动化测试与页面性能分析工具，支持无头浏览器模式运行主流测试框架，提供 DOM 操作、网络监控、屏幕捕获及性能指标采集功能，API 简洁且符合 W3C 标准，已在微博、Cisco、腾讯等企业落地应用。
repos.summary_en: berserkJS is a Qt-based frontend automation and performance analysis tool that supports headless browser testing with mainstream frameworks, offering DOM manipulation, network monitoring, screenshot capture, and performance metrics collection. Its W3C-compliant APIs are simple and production-proven in enterprises like Sina Weibo, Cisco, and Tencent.

repos.description: AI generate code
repos.summary_zh: needware.dev 是一个开源的 AI 驱动全栈开发平台，支持在浏览器中直接生成、预览和部署 Web 应用。通过多智能体系统，可将文本描述、截图或 URL 转化为完整代码，集成 Supabase 数据库、实时预览和代码编辑器，实现从想法到产品的全流程开发。
repos.summary_en: needware.dev is an open-source AI-powered full-stack development platform that generates, previews, and deploys web applications directly in the browser. It leverages a multi-agent system to transform text, screenshots, or URLs into functional code, with integrated Supabase database, real-time preview, and code editor for end-to-end development.

repos.description: AI 时代的 Vibe Coding 实践：使用 Claude Code 从零开发 AI 漫剧生成平台的完整记录，涵盖技术选型、AI 驱动开发、UI 优化与功能迭代全流程。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目记录使用 Claude Code 实践 AI 时代 Vibe Coding 的完整过程，聚焦 AI 漫剧生成平台的开发。通过自然语言描述需求驱动开发，结合 superpowers、frontend-design 等技能实现 TDD 开发流程与 UI 优化，采用 SPEC 规范定义接口标准，体现文档即代码的核心理念。
repos.summary_en: This project documents the complete practice of Vibe Coding in the AI era using Claude Code to develop an AI comic animation platform. It demonstrates natural language-driven development, leveraging skills like superpowers and frontend-design for TDD workflows and UI optimization, while implementing SPEC specifications to define API standards, embodying the core philosophy that documentation is code.

repos.description: 基于IP的真实地址生成器
repos.summary_zh: 基于IP的真实地址生成器，通过调用ipapi、RandomUser等API，根据用户IP或指定地区自动生成包含姓名、电话、地址、SSN等信息的虚拟身份数据，支持地图展示、本地保存与导出，适用于测试、演示等场景。
repos.summary_en: An IP-based real address generator that uses APIs like ipapi and RandomUser to generate realistic virtual identities including name, phone, address, and SSN based on user IP or selected region. Features map display, local storage, export, and responsive UI for testing and demo purposes.

repos.description: ✨一个部署在CF的轻量化导航页面，可移动卡片式书签，方便管理
repos.summary_zh: Card-Tab 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的轻量化书签管理页面，采用卡片式布局支持拖拽排序、分类管理和暗色主题切换。具备多搜索引擎集成、JWT登录验证、KV存储备份及实时天气显示等功能，适合个人快速搭建个性化导航站。
repos.summary_en: Card-Tab is a lightweight bookmark management page deployed on Cloudflare Workers, featuring card-based layout with drag-and-drop sorting, custom categories, dark mode, and multi-engine search. It supports JWT authentication, KV storage backups, and real-time weather display for personalized navigation.

repos.description: TTS Azure Web 是一个 Azure 文本转语音（TTS）网页应用，可以在本地或者云端使用你的 Azure Key 一键部署。TTS Azure Web is an Azure Text-to-Speech (TTS) web application. It allows you to run it locally or deploy it with a single click using your Azure Key.
repos.summary_zh: TTS Azure Web 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 React 19 的 Azure 文本转语音（TTS）网页应用，支持 SSML 精细调优、多语言语音定制及一键部署。提供 Normal/SSML 双模式切换、音频参数调节与导出功能，适用于快速集成 Azure TTS 能力至本地或云端环境。
repos.summary_en: TTS Azure Web is a Next.js 15 and React 19-based web application for Azure Text-to-Speech (TTS), enabling fine-grained voice control via SSML. It supports dual-mode operation (UI/SSML), audio export, and one-click deployment with Azure credentials, ideal for rapid integration of Azure TTS into local or cloud environments.

repos.description: 😃 md 编辑器使用的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步到多个内容平台。
repos.summary_zh: COSE 是一款专为 Markdown 编辑器设计的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步至 30+ 主流内容平台。核心亮点包括跨平台同步、自动登录检测、标签页分组管理，尤其针对微信公众号提供样式保留与草稿自动保存功能，全程本地运行保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: COSE is a browser extension designed for Markdown editors, enabling one-click article publishing to 30+ platforms. Key features include cross-platform sync, auto-login detection, tab grouping, and full CSS preservation for WeChat Official Accounts. Runs entirely locally with zero data collection.

repos.description: (Deprecated) WeUI Components with love of vue.js
repos.summary_zh: vue-weui 是一个已停止维护的 Vue 组件库，封装了 WeUI 0.4.0+ 的微信风格 UI 组件，完全解耦 CSS 样式，支持按需引入以优化包体积，适用于移动端 Web 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-weui is a deprecated Vue component library that encapsulates WeUI 0.4.0+ components for WeChat Web apps. It decouples CSS for full customization and supports selective imports to minimize bundle size.

repos.description: django-debug-toolbar in WebKit DevTools. Works fine with background Ajax requests and non-HTML responses.
repos.summary_zh: Django Debug Panel 将 Django Debug Toolbar 集成至 WebKit DevTools，支持 AJAX 请求和 HTML 响应外的调试场景，专为单页应用和 AJAX 密集型项目设计，提供浏览器内实时调试能力。
repos.summary_en: Django Debug Panel embeds the Django Debug Toolbar into WebKit DevTools, enabling debugging for AJAX requests and non-HTML responses. Ideal for single-page and AJAX-heavy applications, it offers in-browser real-time debugging.

repos.description: A Web-app for OpenManus
repos.summary_zh: OpenManusWeb 是一个基于 OpenManus 的 Web 应用，提供无需邀请码即可使用的 AI 智能体服务。该项目由 MetaGPT 团队开发，支持快速部署和自定义代理任务，具备完整的网页界面和演示视频，适用于自动化任务处理和智能决策场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenManusWeb is a web application built on OpenManus that enables access to AI agents without an invite code. Developed by the MetaGPT team, it offers customizable agent workflows with a user-friendly interface, supporting automation tasks and intelligent decision-making through a complete web-based platform.

repos.description: The first browser AI Agent extension to support Agent Skills, enabling AI to perform complex tasks through an expandable skill system. 🌟 Star if you like it! | 首个支持 Agent Skills 的浏览器 AI Agent 扩展，让 AI 通过可扩展技能系统执行复杂任务 🌟 如果喜欢请点个 Star！
repos.summary_zh: Tactus 是首个支持 Agent Skills 规范的浏览器 AI Agent 扩展，通过可扩展技能系统让 AI 执行复杂任务。支持多模型对话、网页内容理解、图像识别及 HTTP MCP 外部工具集成，具备脚本安全执行与信任机制，实现高效自动化操作。
repos.summary_en: Tactus is the first browser AI Agent extension implementing the Agent Skills specification, enabling complex task execution via an extensible skill system. It supports multi-model conversations, page understanding, vision capabilities, and HTTP MCP integration, with secure script execution and user trust controls for efficient automation.

repos.description: AI 图像编辑 Web 应用，使用 **FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]** 前沿模型提供强大的图像编辑功能，支持Stripe支付，注册登录，积分系统等，代码100%开源。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 15 构建的现代化 AI 图像编辑 Web 应用，集成前沿 FLUX.1 Kontext Pro 模型，支持智能编辑、背景移除、多格式输出及 Stripe 支付，提供完整的用户认证、积分系统和国际化支持，代码完全开源。
repos.summary_en: A modern AI image editing web app built with Next.js 15, powered by the cutting-edge FLUX.1 Kontext Pro model. Features intelligent editing, background removal, multi-format support, Stripe payments, user authentication, points system, and full internationalization, with 100% open-source code.

repos.description: AI图像生成网页交互平台 - 基于Streamlit构建的Web应用，提供简洁的用户界面和实用的图像生成功能
repos.summary_zh: ShowImageWeb是基于Streamlit构建的AI图像生成网页交互平台，提供简洁美观的用户界面和强大的图像生成功能。支持多API服务、CloudScraper反爬虫技术、多尺寸输出、步数调节及本地Key保存，适配移动端并具备固定画廊、实时进度显示和一键下载等实用特性。
repos.summary_en: ShowImageWeb is an AI image generation web platform built with Streamlit, offering a clean UI and robust image generation features. It supports multiple APIs, CloudScraper anti-crawling tech, adjustable steps/sizes, local API key storage, mobile optimization, fixed gallery, real-time progress tracking, and one-click PNG downloads.

repos.description: Building WebApp in Android way.
repos.summary_zh: Jndroid 是一个 JavaScript 框架，允许开发者以 Android 原生应用的方式构建 WebApp。它通过提供类似 Android 的 UI 组件（如 TextView）和 setContentView 等 API，简化了 Web 应用的开发流程，适用于需要跨平台或移动端体验优化的场景。
repos.summary_en: Jndroid is a JavaScript framework enabling WebApp development in an Android-like manner. It provides Android-style UI components (e.g., TextView) and APIs like setContentView, simplifying cross-platform mobile web app development with native-like structure.

repos.description: 🎸吉他和弦图生成、指板分析、和声进行的综合乐理WebApp
repos.summary_zh: Buitar 是一款基于 Tone.js 和 React 的吉他学习 WebApp，提供和弦指位图生成、指板分析、和声进行可视化及多乐器音色切换功能，支持五度圈和弦转换与趣味音序机，具备 PWA 安装能力，适合吉他初学者系统掌握乐理知识。
repos.summary_en: Buitar is a guitar learning web app built with Tone.js and React, offering chord diagram generation, fretboard analysis, harmonic progression visualization, multi-instrument sound switching (guitar, bass, piano, etc.), circle of fifths navigation, and a fun sequencer. It supports PWA installation for offline use, ideal for systematic music theory mastery.

repos.description: 🤖 A beautiful web tool for comparing AI model responses side-by-side. Test prompts across different LLMs and find the best model for your needs.
repos.summary_zh: AI模型对比工具提供并排对比不同大语言模型的响应能力，支持多轮对话、API配置管理、响应时间统计及一键复制功能，适用于开发者快速评估各模型性能表现。
repos.summary_en: A web-based tool for side-by-side comparison of AI model responses, supporting multi-turn conversations, API configuration management, response time tracking, and one-click copying to evaluate LLM performance efficiently.

repos.description: TTS WEB
repos.summary_zh: Text2Voice Web 是一个基于 Cloudflare Pages 的文本转语音（TTS）Web 应用，支持通过 API 调用生成语音并提供试听与下载功能。前端采用 Bootstrap 构建，设计简洁美观，集成历史记录与多后端 API 支持（Cloudflare Workers 和 Deno），适合快速部署私有语音服务。
repos.summary_en: Text2Voice Web is a text-to-speech (TTS) web application built with Bootstrap, enabling users to convert text into audio via API calls with preview and download features. It supports deployment on Cloudflare Pages and integrates multiple backends including Cloudflare Workers and Deno for flexible, private TTS service hosting.

repos.description: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 浏览器扩展，旨在提升用户阅读微信公众号文章的体验。通过自动生成文章的结构化目录，让您轻松了解文章结构、快速导航到感兴趣的部分，并在阅读长文时保持位置感知。
repos.summary_zh: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 扩展，专为优化电脑端阅读微信公众号长文体验而设计。核心功能包括自动生成结构化目录、图片放大预览、链接智能识别与跳转，以及阅读位置实时追踪，显著提升信息获取效率与视觉舒适度。
repos.summary_en: WeChat Reader Enhancer is a Chrome extension designed to improve the reading experience of WeChat Official Account articles on desktop. It features auto-generated structured table of contents, image zoom-in preview, URL recognition and clickable linking, and real-time reading position tracking, significantly enhancing content navigation and visual comfort.

repos.description: 一个基于Web技术构建，所见即所得的在线简谱编辑器
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于Web的在线简谱编辑器，提供所见即所得的编辑体验，支持全键盘输入音符、一键转调及高清图片导出功能，适用于音乐创作与教学场景，暂不支持移动端和五线谱。
repos.summary_en: A web-based numerical notation editor offering WYSIWYG editing, full keyboard note input, one-click transposition, and high-resolution image export for sheet music creation and education.

repos.description: 一个用于 New API 的可嵌入状态页面，支持展示服务状态、可用性和监控信息。
repos.summary_zh: New API Status Embed 是一个专为 new-api 设计的可嵌入状态监控页面，通过拉取管理日志接口数据，按模型和时间窗口聚合展示服务可用性。支持 iframe 嵌入、多时间粒度切换、自动刷新及模型白名单过滤，适用于独立状态子站或主站集成。
repos.summary_en: New API Status Embed is an embeddable status dashboard for new-api that aggregates request logs by model and time window. It provides real-time service availability monitoring with iframe support, customizable time ranges, auto-refresh, and model whitelisting, ideal for standalone status pages or integration into main sites.

repos.description: 浏览器AI插件，一键把网页文章内容生成为思维导图，很方便。
repos.summary_zh: doc2mindmap 是一款浏览器AI插件，可将网页文章内容一键转换为思维导图，支持自定义大模型API接口。基于Chrome扩展开发，集成AI能力实现内容结构化呈现，适合知识整理与学习场景，代码开源便于学习浏览器插件与AI结合的开发模式。
repos.summary_en: doc2mindmap is a browser AI plugin that converts web page content into mind maps with one click. It supports custom LLM APIs and uses Chrome extension technology to integrate AI capabilities for content structuring, ideal for knowledge organization and learning. The open-source code serves as a practical example of combining browser plugins with AI models.

repos.description: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini 能力的 Chrome 扩展程序。它不仅仅是一个侧边栏插件，而是通过注入式的悬浮工具栏、强大的图像 AI 处理以及前沿的浏览器控制协议 (MCP)，将 AI 的触角伸向网页浏览的每一个交互细节。
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Nova 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini AI 的 Chrome 扩展程序，通过悬浮工具栏、图像 AI 处理及浏览器控制协议 (MCP) 实现网页交互智能化。支持多驱动方案（Web Client/官方 API/OpenAI兼容），提供侧边栏对话、划词翻译总结、Mermaid 图表渲染、OCR 截图翻译及外部 MCP 工具集成等核心功能，赋予浏览器原生 AI 能力。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Nova is a Chrome extension deeply integrated with Google Gemini AI, enabling intelligent web interaction via floating toolbars, image AI processing, and Browser Control Protocol (MCP). It supports multiple backends (Web Client/Official API/OpenAI-compatible), offering features like sidebar chat, text translation/summary, Mermaid chart rendering, OCR screenshot translation, and external MCP tool integration for enhanced agentic capabilities.

repos.summary_zh: GuiTabs 是一个吉他谱在线展示工具，支持用户上传、编辑和实时预览吉他谱。基于 Web 技术实现，提供直观的界面与交互功能，适用于音乐爱好者和吉他手快速浏览与分享乐谱。
repos.summary_en: GuiTabs is an online guitar tablature viewer that enables users to upload, edit, and preview guitar tabs in real time. Built with web technologies, it offers an intuitive interface for musicians to browse and share tabs efficiently.

repos.description: 基于service worker与单页面应用的静态页面博客系统
repos.summary_zh: swBlog 是一个基于 Service Worker 和单页应用（SPA）的静态博客系统，支持 Markdown 写作、离线阅读与搜索功能。可部署于 GitHub Pages 或 CDN，具备文章分类、标签生成及自动化构建流程，适用于个人技术博客与知识分享场景。
repos.summary_en: swBlog is a static blog system built with Service Worker and SPA, supporting Markdown writing, offline reading, and search. Deployable on GitHub Pages or CDN, it auto-generates categories/tags from file structure and enables automated builds via npm scripts for personal tech blogs.
